summary: Phase 2 interim review — Step 4 of 12 completed: Better Auth foundation (Step 2), runtime auth and workspace access (Step 3), workspace creation and selection (Step 4: BUSINESS workspace with the session user as OWNER, workspace + membership + workspace.created audit in one transaction, strict input and slug rules, /workspaces and /workspaces/new pages, minimal /w/{slug} landing page). Phase 2 is not complete; Steps 5–12 remain.
risks: Auth rate limiting is disabled until its dedicated step because it needs a trusted client IP source.
Better Auth stores raw session tokens in the sessions table; accepted with controls (HMAC-signed cookie, auth tables unreachable from application code).
AUTH_SECRET is validated on first auth use rather than at boot, so a missing value makes auth requests fail closed.
Email verification, password reset and the mailer are not implemented yet (later Phase 2 steps).
Gitleaks secret scanning runs only in CI.
recommended_next_action: Human review of Step 4, then explicit approval before Step 5 starts.
